description: Draft synthetic longitudinal data contract for issue #1. All records are generated; none are derived from real patients. Not suitable for clinical inference.

versioning.major: Removing or renaming a field, changing a type, unit, or the meaning of a value.
versioning.minor: Adding an optional field, table, or allowed categorical value.
versioning.patch: Documentation or generator fixes that do not change the schema.

subjects.description: One row per synthetic subject. Static attributes at coarse granularity only.

fields.name: subject_key
fields.description: Opaque synthetic subject key. Random, not derived from any identity.

fields.name: sex
fields.description: Recorded sex. U = unknown or not recorded.

fields.name: age_band
fields.description: Age band at enrolment. Exact age and birth date are never generated.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Synthetic coarse region code. Does not map to a real geography.

fields.name: enrolled_on
fields.description: Date the subject's synthetic record starts.

encounters.description: One row per synthetic care contact. Observations attach to an encounter.

fields.name: encounter_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp of the encounter, minute precision.

observations.description: One row per marker measurement scheduled at an encounter. Long format.

fields.name: encounter_id
fields.description: Encounter at which the observation was taken.

fields.name: observed_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp of the measurement, equal to the encounter timestamp in v0.1.0.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Measured value in the marker's unit. Null when the measurement was scheduled but not resulted.

fields.name: source_kind
fields.description: Ingestion payload kind as accepted by datalife-datalake-core.

fields.name: missing_reason
fields.description: Why value is null. Null when value is present.

missingness.unscheduled: A marker not measured at an encounter has no row. Absence of a row is structural, not missing data.
missingness.not_resulted: A scheduled laboratory marker (GLU, HBA1C, HGB) whose result never arrived has a row with value null and missing_reason not_resulted.

clinical_plausibility.blood_pressure: SBP and DBP are recorded together at an encounter; DBP is always below SBP.
clinical_plausibility.visit_hours: Routine and telehealth encounters fall on weekdays 08:00-17:00 UTC; urgent encounters any day 07:00-23:00 UTC. At most one encounter per subject per day.
clinical_plausibility.glucose: GLU is fasting glucose and is generated consistently with HBA1C.

temporal_semantics.window: All encounter and observation timestamps fall on or after the subject's enrolled_on date and inside the configured generation window.
temporal_semantics.ordering: Files are written sorted by each table's sort_by keys.
